mapper.select: SELECT agreement_document_id, agreement_id, document_type, file_id, content_hash FROM t_agreement_document_ref WHERE agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR (local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER') AND agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement_operating_entity WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId})))) ORDER BY agreement_document_id
